name: FunkWave VR Player
summary:
FunkWave VR Player is a premium virtual reality media player designed to deliver immersive, high-quality visual and audio experiences from FunkWave Universe.

Built as a dedicated VR playback environment, FunkWave VR Player allows users to stream and experience curated first-party content, including original music, visualizers, and cinematic VR presentations created specifically for the FunkWave Universe platform.
